title: Exclusive: Metro Exodus Enhanced Edition Analysis - The First Triple-A Game Built Around Ray Tracing
summary: Digital Foundry's Alex Battaglia analyzes Metro Exodus Enhanced Edition, the first AAA game built around ray tracing. It covers the new global illumination, emissive lighting, DLSS and performance on AMD and Nvidia hardware.
why: HN recommends it as a good overview of what ray-traced lighting changes for developers and players.

quote.text: is a good overview of why this is such a huge leap forward for developers and players alike.
